description: Ministry of Finance Economic Stabilization and National Policies - General Public is hereby Informed of the Closure of liquidation of the Internal Trade Department - General Public is hereby informed of the closure of liquidation of the Department of Telecommunication
reasoning: This gazette content announces the closure and liquidation of two government departments (Internal Trade Department and Department of Telecommunication). It describes structural/administrative changes (dissolving departments) without naming any specific individuals or detailing their portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses solely on government organizational changes, fitting the definition of Organisational Gazette (Type 1).
